senses.def: A former volost of Mykolaiv povit, Mykolaiv governorate, Ukrainian Soviet Socialist Republic, extant in 1921, abolished a. 1923.
Former name of Pliushchivka silrada: a former silrada of Bashtanka Raion, Mykolaiv Oblast, Ukraine; known by this name until 1945.
A transliteration of the Russian male given name Ефре́м (Jefrém).
